candidate: Per-cell border-plane illumination removal and robust ink-depth normalization; maximum paired-cell RMS difference >= fixed threshold flags an inconsistency.
baseline: Maximum paired-cell raw grayscale RMS difference >= the same fixed threshold; same contrast abstention rule.
grouping: Every variant of a synthetic identity/specimen belongs to exactly one synthetic device profile, and every device profile belongs to exactly one split. Common procedural digit skeletons are shared; this is not independent font-family validation.
training: No fitting. TRAIN is a separately frozen diagnostic and exportable augmentation source; neither threshold nor parameters selected from its outcomes.
denominators: 48 specimens x 14 conditions per split = 672 pairs; 384 benign and 288 attacks. Abstentions/errors are incorrect in primary accuracy, never successful attack detection. Also report attack clear/pass separately from abstain/error, and all paired regressions.
scope: Oracle paired fixed-width glyph crops, no OCR/localization and no shipping baseline. Artificial alteration labels describe generator interventions, not laboratory-authenticated ink or real forgery.
gate: Retain as research only if DEV correct increases, no baseline-correct item regresses, no newly clear attack, no increased false flag on benigns. No production promotion even if this synthetic gate passes.
privacy: All generated pixels, strings, per-specimen metadata/scores and receipts remain owner-private outside git. Only aggregate results and program/config hashes may be published. No existing datasets/caches or TEST/reserved paths are opened.
